Name: Orange Salmonberries
Author: tails2356
Description:
Changes the salmonberry item, and bushes to be orange, as in my own personal experience with salmonberries, the red ones are far less common than orange.  Some map recolours also turn the berries on the bushes orange, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url]﻿, which is a mod I highly recommend.

For those using mods that recolour the game's bushes, this mod's bush override can be disabled in the config.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Orange Salmonberries
Manifest.Description: Changes the colour of salmonberries to orange instead of red.
Manifest.Author: Zelaphor
